label: Vague or generic environmental term
rationale: Broad benefit terms without substantiation are the most common misleading claim
source: EU Directive (EU) 2024/825 (ECGT) Annex I; UK CMA Green Claims Code principle 2

label: Absolute or neutrality claim
rationale: Absolute claims need the highest level of substantiation; product-level neutrality claims based on offsets are banned under EU ECGT
source: EU Directive 2024/825 Annex I 4c; CMA Green Claims Code principle 2

label: Superlative or leadership claim
rationale: Comparative or leadership claims need a fair, verifiable basis of comparison

label: Overgeneralisation
rationale: A benefit for one product or site presented as company-wide

pattern: \b(significantly|dramatically|massively|drastically|huge(?:ly)?|tremendous(?:ly)?|transform(?:s|ing)? the (?:industry|world)|revolutionary|game[- ]chang\w*|save the planet|reverse climate change|solve climate change)\b
label: Exaggerated impact
rationale: Magnitude words without numbers cannot be verified

label: Relies on offsets
rationale: Neutrality based on offsetting rather than reductions is banned for product claims under EU ECGT
source: EU Directive 2024/825 Annex I 4c; SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard

pattern: \b(aim(?:s|ing)? to|aspir(?:e|es|ation|ing)|strive(?:s)? to|striving|hope(?:s)? to|seek(?:s|ing)? to|ambition(?:s)?|endeavou?r|work(?:ing)? towards?|journey|committed to (?:becoming|being|a|making))\b
label: Aspirational without plan
rationale: Future pledges need a time-bound, independently monitored implementation plan

label: Quantified
rationale: A number with a unit or percentage can be checked

label: Dated (year stated)
rationale: A target year or reporting year makes the claim testable

label: Baseline stated
rationale: Reductions are only meaningful against a stated base year
source: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard ch. 5; IFRS S2 para 33

pattern: \b(scope\s?[123]|scopes? 1(?:,| and| &) ?2|value[- ]chain emissions|ghg protocol|operational emissions|absolute emissions|emissions intensity|per (?:tonne|unit|kwh|barrel|boe))\b
label: Scope or boundary defined
Third-party verification
rationale: External assurance or certification makes the claim verifiable
source: CMA principle 6; EU Green Claims proposal Art. 10

label: Concrete action
rationale: Past, concrete actions are easier to verify than promises
